title: PandoraMC Modpack
description: Modpack of multiple mods that we use on the PandaroMC server. Full credits goes to makers of the mods. This is a modpack to make an easy and fast way for players to get all the mods.
body:
**This modpack is intended for use on the PandoraMC server. For the best experience, it is recommended to play on play.PandoraMC.net.**

The pack is designed as a _complete multiplayer-focused experience, carefully balancing the strengths of modded Minecraft with the familiarity and feel of vanilla gameplay_. The goal is to enhance usability and visuals while preserving core Minecraft mechanics, ensuring the experience remains intuitive and fair for all players.

It is primarily aimed at modded players and multiplayer servers, with PandoraMC as its main target. Several mods have been custom-configured to improve multiplayer balance and stability, including adjusted item values and mechanics to prevent modded systems from overpowering vanilla progression. This ensures a consistent and competitive experience across the server.

Rather than acting as a minimal base, this modpack is intended to be a fully playable end product. While it offers room for expansion, no additional mods are required to enjoy the intended gameplay on PandoraMC. Certain features (such as minimaps) are deliberately excluded to promote exploration, communication, and cooperative play within the server community.

Ease of use is a key principle of this pack. It is kept simple to install and maintain, making it suitable for both players and server administrators who want a reliable, purpose-built modpack without unnecessary complexity.

While rapid updates to new Minecraft versions are not the primary focus, the pack provides a stable foundation tailored to PandoraMC. Support is available directly through the pack author, particularly for issues related to server compatibility, configuration, or gameplay balance.

_A detailed list of included mods is available per version on Modrinth._
